headline: THE BOT HASN'T FILED ITS FIRST REPORT YET

sections.heading: WHAT GOES HERE
sections.body: This file is written by the weekly-summary managed agent via the GitHub MCP toolset. Every run creates a new file at content/weekly-summaries/<season>-w<week, zero-padded to 2 digits>.json (this file is the placeholder for week 0) and prepends a matching entry to content/weekly-summaries/index.json. See index.json and README.md in this directory for the exact contract.
